description.value: The shell that protects most of your body has always been a part of you, and it has taught you valuable lessons in improving your defense and mobility when wearing armor. You gain the armor specialization effect of light armor. If you're trained in medium or heavy armor, you gain the respective armor specialization effects of those armors as well and reduce the Speed penalty of medium and heavy armor by 5 feet.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
